title: 第446章 老板换一批第445章 各怀鬼胎崩溃的二人组
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 中州大陆的核心之地，天穹中浮着一颗发光星球。
星球通体散发着冷白色光芒，宛如一颗通透的琉璃珠子镶嵌在碧空，散发着一股冷幽静谧的气息……
这颗星球上，有着玄黄大世界最大的三座主城之一——星月城！
创始者星月大帝，曾征服虚空，徒手摘星辰，将其炼制为自身本命帝器。
星月城便由此而来！
星月城和通天城同为顶级大城，但繁华程度却比通天城高出不止一个层次。
通天城幅员辽阔，五域所有修炼者皆可踏足于此交易，没有太多条条框框的束缚，对入城者也没有太多要求。
城中交易的物品也是各个档次都有。
但星月城不同，入城门槛极高。
首先，得有踏空而行，登上星月城的能力。
其次，也要有能力穿过星月城外布置的隔绝法阵，当然，一些大家族的子弟有强者协助入城除外……
星月大帝是玄黄大世界的老牌大帝，实力深不可测。
她定下规矩，星月城禁止内打斗厮杀。
不少强者斥巨资在星月城购买居所，为的便是寻求星月大帝的庇佑，久而久之，星月城的居所也成为了五域强者们身份地位的象征……
星月城内，繁华异常。
整颗星球在发光，星月城也在发光。
城内所有建筑皆由冷玉打造，装饰造型精致奇特，美轮美奂。
地面也并非普通的石头材质，而是那种散发着阵阵清凉之意的冷玉，踏足其上，浑身清凉舒爽异常。
一道年轻的白衣身影在街道上快步而行，神识在街旁的商铺中扫过，没有丝毫逗留，直奔城中最繁华的天门商会而去。
“小仙仙～星月城很有意思的，城主还是个大美人哦，你不好好逛逛？”
“没兴趣。”
星月城很繁华，却让秦然很没安全感。
毕竟，这是别人的帝器，自己的安危在这里可没有什么保障。
很快，它停在了一座足有百米高的冷玉建筑前，建筑前方挂着一个大大的牌匾，上面龙飞凤舞的二字“天门”。
天门商会不仅做拍卖生意，它也是玄黄大世界最大的交易商会之一。
不过，因为前几日通天城拍卖会的原因，这几日，天门商会的生意冷清了不少。
秦然踏足其中。
商会内客人不多，但随便一位都是大圣境以上强者，天尊境和大天尊也是随处可见。
整栋楼里，准帝气息不下十位！
走在他前面的一个身材丰腴的紫色旗袍女人，更是让他完全探不出深浅……
“小仙仙～你如果想搞钱的话，其实可以尝试攻略星月大帝试试，她可一直都是单身哦～”
秦然皱眉，“没兴趣！”
“姐姐是认真的～星月城内寸土寸金，且不说那些固定居所，光是这些商行的利润分成和租金，都是天价数字！若论真正身价，星月大帝怕是比黄金家族的小老头都要多一些～”
“我知道。”
作为原作者，他岂能不知道星月大帝这隐藏富婆？
“你知道？”小云云诧异。
“以你爱钱的性子，既然知道她有钱，为何会说没兴趣？”
“废话，当然是因为她太老了。”
秦然说出这句话的时候，整个人感受到了一股莫名寒意。
content_en:
In the core of Zhongzhou Continent, there is a luminous planet floating in the sky.
The entire planet exudes cold white light, like a transparent glass bead embedded in the blue sky, exuding a cold and quiet atmosphere...
On this planet, there is one of the three largest main cities in the Xuanhuang World—Xingyue City!
The founder, Emperor Xingyue, once conquered the void, picked stars with his bare hands, and refined them into his own imperial weapon.
This is where Xingyue City comes from!
Xingyue City and Tongtian City are both top cities, but their prosperity is more than one level higher than Tongtian City.
Tongtian City has a vast territory, and all cultivators from the five domains can set foot in this trade. There are not many restrictions, and there are not many requirements for those who enter the city.
Items traded in the city are also available at all levels.
But Xingyue City is different. The threshold for entering the city is extremely high.
First of all, you must have the ability to walk in the air and board the Star-Moon City.
Secondly, you must also be able to pass through the isolation circle set up outside Xingyue City, of course, except for the children of some big families who have the help of strong men to enter the city...
Emperor Xingyue is the veteran emperor of the Xuanhuang World, and his strength is unfathomable.
She made a rule that fighting and killing were prohibited in Xingyue City.
Many powerful people spent huge sums of money to buy residences in Xingyue City in order to seek the blessing of Emperor Xingyue. Over time, the residences in Xingyue City also became a symbol of status for the powerful people in the Five Realms...
Xingyue City is extremely prosperous.
The entire planet is glowing, and Star-Moon City is also glowing.
All the buildings in the city are made of cold jade, and the decorations are exquisite and unique in shape and beautiful.
The ground is not made of ordinary stone, but the kind of cold jade that exudes a refreshing feeling. When you step on it, your whole body will feel cool and comfortable.
A young figure in white walked quickly on the street. His consciousness swept through the shops on the street. Without stopping at all, he went straight to the most prosperous Tianmen Chamber of Commerce in the city.
"Xiao Xianxian~ Xingyue City is very interesting. The city owner is also a great beauty. Why don't you take a stroll?"
"Not interested."
Star-Moon City was very prosperous, but it made Qin Ran very insecure.
After all, this is someone else's imperial weapon, and there is no guarantee for your own safety here.
Soon, it stopped in front of a cold jade building that was a hundred meters high. In front of the building hung a large plaque with the two characters "Tianmen" in flying phoenixes.
The Tianmen Chamber of Commerce is not only engaged in auction business, it is also one of the largest trading chambers in the Xuanhuang World.
However, due to the Tongtian City auction a few days ago, the Tianmen Chamber of Commerce's business has been a lot deserted these days.
Qin Ran stepped into it.
There are not many guests in the Chamber of Commerce, but every one of them is a powerful person above the Great Saint Realm, and the Heavenly Lord Realm and the Great Heavenly Lord can also be seen everywhere.
There are no less than ten quasi-emperors in the whole building!
The plump purple cheongsam woman walking in front of him made it even more difficult for him to figure out the depth...
"Xiao Xianxian~ If you want to make money, you can actually try to conquer Xingyue Emperor. She has always been single~"
Kieran frowned, "Not interested!"
"Sister, I'm serious! Every inch of land in Xingyue City is precious. Not to mention the fixed residences, the profit sharing and rent of these businesses are sky-high figures! In terms of true worth, Emperor Xingyue is probably worth more than the little old man of the Golden Family~"
"I know."
As the original author, how could he not know that Emperor Xingyue is a hidden rich woman?
"You know?" Xiao Yunyun was surprised.
"Yeah."
"With your money-loving temperament, why would you say you're not interested if you know she has money?"
"Nonsense, of course it's because she's too old."
When Qin Ran said these words, his whole body felt an inexplicable chill.
